EU sanctions Russian propagandist Xenia Fedorova

The European Union has imposed sanctions on Xenia Fedorova, accusing her of disseminating pro-Russian narratives in France and the EU in the context of Russia's war against Ukraine. Fedorova was recently expelled from France. The sanctions listing was published on Thursday.
